batch.description: RU C Unit Science third-party question-bank capture, session 2024-2025, source variant ruc-group1. Question/option text was extracted from the source site's paginated HTML/API. All third-party answer keys are unverified candidates, and exam rules are not asserted. Source API listed 129 records; 1 malformed/incomplete item(s) excluded with reasons in REVIEW/LOKKHO_EXCLUDED_INCOMPLETE_ITEMS.csv. All retained answer keys and text are unverified candidates pending source/key review. Science-core subset generated from source-bank capture on 2026-10-29: 127 records in Physics/Chemistry/ICT/Biology/Higher Mathematics. 1 records with other source subject labels are held in REVIEW/LOKKHO_OFFSCOPE_SUBJECT_AUDIT.csv pending session-specific verification. All retained content and candidate keys remain unverified; this is not scored-practice approval.

sourceDocuments.notes: Public third-party question-bank page: https://lokkho.org/ru-c-2024-2025-ruc-group1-mcq/mcq. Paginated source route: https://lokkho.org/api/question-set/ru-c-2024-2025-ruc-group1-mcq/questions?qtype=mcq&page={page}&per_page=30. Source reports 129 MCQ records over 5 API pages. This is a third-party question-bank dataset, not an official RU-hosted original-paper scan. The site's data-correct-answer values are candidate keys and are kept unverified; no official RU key was independently checked. Exam rules are intentionally omitted rather than inferred from the practice-bank configuration. Questions with images or formulas that need additional review remain contentVerificationStatus=unverified. Local media assets, where downloadable, are listed in assets/lokkho/ and research/LOKKHO_MEDIA_MANIFEST.csv. Finalization excluded 1 source record(s) lacking two valid options or required prompt/option text. Retained question text has not been independently cross-checked against the original printed paper; contentVerificationStatus is unverified. All provided keys remain unverified candidates. Curated Science-core export contains 127 records from the source variant; 1 records labelled outside the core subject set are held in a separate review ledger. The official/current subject scope must not be assumed to prove every historical page variant; confirm each old session against an original source before promoting any record.
